requirements.title: The listed events make a pointer become disassociated
requirements.definition: A pointer becomes disassociated by NULLIFY, DEALLOCATE of the pointer, pointer assignment to a disassociated pointer, SOURCE= allocation from a disassociated pointer subobject, or default initialization of a pointer subcomponent to NULL through INTENT(OUT), unsaved local, BLOCK local, or allocation events.
requirements.oracle:
Source registration only. Future fixtures establish a distinguished non-default state first, then observe only portable single-image properties: exact integer, logical, character, type, rank, bounds, ASSOCIATED inquiry results for defined pointer association status, or required syntax diagnostics owned by a numbered rule. Undefined pointer association status and undefined definition status are never inspected, dereferenced, invoked, compared, or passed to ASSOCIATED as an oracle.

S19.5.2.4-001 pointer-association runtime fixtures: two programs cover all listed disassociated-status events. One establishes associated states before NULLIFY, DEALLOCATE, and pointer assignment to a disassociated pointer, then observes ASSOCIATED false. The other observes SOURCE= allocation from a disassociated pointer subobject and NULL default pointer component effects for INTENT(OUT), unsaved local, BLOCK local, and allocation without SOURCE=. Feature mutants replace the disassociating event by a conforming association-preserving event.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Unnumbered program restrictions are source-control restrictions only. Notes are informative. Coarray, image, team, companion-processor lifetime, volatile-interference, addresses, diagnostic wording, exit status details, and processor-dependent representations are not asserted.

S19.5.2.4-001 pointer-association fixture boundaries: only single-image defined association statuses, exact integer values, character length/equality, bounds inquiries, and SELECT TYPE reachability are asserted. Undefined pointer association status and undefined definition status are not inspected, passed to ASSOCIATED, dereferenced, compared, or used as diagnostic oracles. Coarray/different-image, companion-processor lifetime, VOLATILE interference, storage/inheritance-association owners, addresses, finalization, and processor-dependent diagnostics remain outside this packet.
